districtFact: Canyons publishes a district K-12 A/B calendar but excludes Brighton High School, which follows its own trimester calendar. Both tracks use Friday early-out schedules, while grade-level orientation, kindergarten opening, conference days, grading days, and trimester or quarter boundaries require track-specific reading.

about.title: Brighton High School Uses a Separate Calendar
about.content: The district K-12 PDFs explicitly say they are not for Brighton students. Brighton starts and ends with the district in the verified future years, but its trimester endings, grading days, parent-teacher conferences, and several professional days differ from the K-12 quarter calendar.

about.title: Friday Is an Early-Out Pattern, Not One Bell Time
about.content: Every verified Canyons K-12 and Brighton PDF says each Friday is an early-out day. The PDFs do not provide one districtwide dismissal time, so families must use the assigned school's bell schedule for transportation and child-care planning.

about.title: Opening Week Is Staggered
about.content: Sixth- and ninth-graders attend half-day orientation before grades 1–12 start. Kindergarten starts two days later. Brighton's separate calendar lists only ninth-grade orientation because it is a high-school-specific schedule.

about.title: Conference Weeks Create Different Dates by Level
about.content: Elementary, middle, and high schools use overlapping but different fall and winter conference dates. The sequence leads into a districtwide early-out day, a compensatory no-student day, and then a professional day in most K-12 years; Brighton follows its own conference and compensation pattern.

about.title: Emergency Closures Become Remote Learning Days
about.content: Each reviewed PDF says school emergency closure days will be made up by scheduling remote-learning days. The calendars do not preassign a fixed make-up date, so an emergency closure should not be converted into a specific attendance date without a later district announcement.

planningTips.title: Canyons School District Calendar Notes
content: Choose the K-12 calendar for most schools, but use the separate Brighton High School calendar for Brighton students.
Pair red A-day and black B-day labels with the student's secondary class schedule; the letters do not mean closure or early dismissal.
Treat each instructional Friday as early out and confirm the actual dismissal time with the school.
Check the student's school level before using parent-teacher conference dates because elementary, middle, high school, and Brighton schedules differ.
Kindergarten begins two days after grades 1-12; the preceding orientation date applies only to sixth and ninth grades on the K-12 track.
Do not assign a fixed weather make-up date: the official calendars say emergency closures will be recovered with later remote-learning days.
The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not repeat every Friday early out or daily A/B letter.

districtFaqs.q: Does Brighton High School use the Canyons K-12 calendar?
districtFaqs.a: No. Each verified K-12 PDF says it is not for Brighton students. Brighton has a separate calendar with trimester endings, grading days, conferences, and some professional days that do not align with the K-12 calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Are Fridays early-out days in Canyons School District?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The reviewed K-12 and Brighton calendars state that every instructional Friday is an early-out day. Families should use the school's bell schedule for the exact dismissal time.

districtFaqs.q: Do Canyons kindergarten students start with grades 1-12?
districtFaqs.a: No. In each reviewed year, grades 1–12 start first and kindergarten begins two days later. Sixth- and ninth-graders also attend half-day orientation before grades 1–12 start.

districtFaqs.q: What do the red and black dates mean on the Canyons calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Red dates are A days and black dates are B days for the secondary rotation. Students should pair the letter with their class schedule rather than treating it as an attendance exception.

districtFaqs.q: How does Canyons make up emergency closure days?
districtFaqs.a: The official PDFs say emergency closure days will be made up by scheduling remote-learning days. No fixed make-up date is printed in advance.
